$comment: The sAGI facet registry. Prose spec: FACET_BUNDLE.md, beside this file. Reserved extensions are owned by this spec version; a fork may add namespaced custom facets but may never redefine a core one.
state_rule: A facet that does not exist is `absent` with a reason in the manifest, or `null_with_reason` inside a file that exists. A plausible-looking value in place of an unmeasured one is a defect, not a placeholder.

persona.spec_url: mindX/mindx/godel/mindxtrain/personas/README.md (mindX-internal, not published; not required to verify a bundle)
persona.role: identity — the source of truth for every derived facet

agent.spec: CAPS spec; renderer mindX/agents/blockchain/facets.py:88 (mindX-internal, not published)
agent.role: the class facet: implementation, domain, capabilities, knowledge domains

model.role: inference POLICY (logical model, task class, pinned true/false) — a policy, not weights

prompt.spec: YAML frontmatter + body; examples in mindX/prompts/**/*.prompt (mindX-internal, not published)
prompt.authority: PER BUNDLE — declared in the file's own frontmatter, not fixed by this registry

authority_values.derived: generated from a charter body and byte-checked on every bind; drift is a HARD ERROR. Frontmatter carries derived_from + derivation. First instance: sAGI.prompt (from .claude/agents/savante.md).
authority_values.source: hand-authored and authoritative; the persona's system_prompt is a COMPRESSED restatement of it, deliberately shorter and NOT byte-linked. Frontmatter carries derived_from: null. First instance: luvai.prompt.

prompt.rule: A bundle MUST declare which. The two directions are both legitimate and produce opposite repairs: for a derived prompt the charter wins and the prompt is regenerated; for a source prompt the prompt wins and the persona is regenerated. Guessing inverts the fix.
prompt.note: This field was originally hardcoded to `derived_from: charter`, which would have declared the correct luvai.prompt to be wrong. Corrected 2026-09-13 after the second instance appeared.

tool.role: capability surface: allowlist, forbidden set, grant mask

skill.role: the invocation surface — how a caller reaches the officer

voaice.role: voice identity; measured:null + vprint:null is the honest unmeasured state

faice.role: face identity; measured:null + fprint:null is the honest unmeasured state

attribute.source: named by mindX/faicey/FAICE.md (mindX-internal, not published); SHAPED 2026-09-12 by personas/luvai.attribute, whose own `defined` field records that no .attribute file existed beforehand
attribute.role: the traits a persona is built FROM — each one a claim carrying a value, a source, and a state
attribute.authority: SOURCE, not derived. Hand-authored; the place a trait is added or retired.
attribute.rule: An attribute with no source is a preference wearing a fact's clothes. `empty` is a legitimate state and is NEVER filled with a plausible guess — a null voiceprint is the truth about a voice that has not been cloned.
attribute.consumed_by: ollywoo/wardrobe.js (internal, not published; not required to verify a bundle), which builds a persona and leaves traits[] empty (wardrobe.js:62); this facet fills it

verse.xml.role: the verse — lines that become the persona's voice_examples
verse.xml.note: A compound extension. The registry matches on the full suffix `verse.xml`, not on `xml`.

aiml.role: model-free rendering — categories built from the persona's exchanges and task.battery
aiml.why: It lets a persona speak with NO MODEL AT ALL. That matters for an officer whose doctrine forbids model pinning: the floor is a deterministic renderer, not an inference call that may be unavailable, metered, or swapped underneath the charter.

agency.spec: defined 2026-09-12 by mindX personas/jaimla.agency (mindX-internal; published copy https://github.com/cryptoAGI/jaimla/blob/main/jaimla.agency), whose own `defined` field records that no .agency file existed anywhere beforehand — so it defines the facet rather than following a convention
agency.preamble: one free-form leading section is permitted and varies by instance (jaimla.agency: 'The rule for this file'; luvai.agency: 'Why this agency is narrow')
agency.role: PERMISSION, not ability. The test for every line: if this actor did it unsupervised, would that be correct? Capability and permission are different facts, and conflating them is how an assistant becomes an actor nobody authorised.
agency.default: deny — absence means not permitted, so a missing line is a refusal and never an oversight
agency.granted_by: the operator, from outside the actor. An actor asking to widen its own agency is a request, not a change.
read_by: the factory before writing a facet
any surface that would let the actor act rather than speak
agency.note: Registered as core because two real instances already use the bare `.agency` extension, which the custom_rule below would otherwise make a HARD ERROR. The alternative — renaming them x-mindx.agency — would have punished correct files to protect a list. Consistency worth recording: jaimla.agency's must_defer names mint, list, bind and register as operator-signature acts, the same doctrine sAGI.tool encodes as enforced_by. Two facets authored independently, agreeing.

mint_outputs.$comment: Written by a mint pipeline as on-chain data lands (mindX/agents/blockchain/facets.py:14-16, mindX-internal, not published), never by an author. Registered as namespaced customs so no author-facet name is ever taken by pipeline output.

custom_rule: An extension outside `core` MUST match custom_pattern and MUST declare {owner, spec_url, media, added_in} in the bundle manifest. An unnamespaced unknown extension is a HARD ERROR, not a warning: it is the one rule that lets the core list grow later without ever colliding with a fork's private facet.
enumeration_note: This core set is the union of two prior, disagreeing enumerations: six facets in mindX/agents/blockchain/facets.py:29 and seven in mindX/faicey/FAICE.md (both mindX-internal, not published; cited as provenance, not required to verify a bundle). walletpublickey/bankon/iNFT moved to mint_outputs because they are not authored.
